about: The one list of Nathan's apps. Live links, which apps show where, and each app's App Store listing (text, highlights, screenshots) all come from here. Edit listings and icons in the Toolbox; the sync job copies them here. Don't hand-edit text in store/index.html.

listing.sub: Cheer and dance counts that lock the team together
listing.desc: Write a cheer or dance routine in 8-counts, then practice it with a big count on screen and the next move coming up. Slow it to 50% to learn it, add your own song, lock every phone onto the same clock so the whole team counts off together, and record a take with the count on top.
feats: A click that stays perfectly even and a number you can read across the gym.
